create_optics_clustering: create an OPTICS clustering model and fit it on a dataset to extract cluster labels
build_optics_graph: build the OPTICS reachability graph returning ordering, core distances, reachability, and predecessors
extract_dbscan_clusters: extract DBSCAN-style clusters from OPTICS results using a specified epsilon value
extract_xi_clusters: extract automatic clusters from OPTICS results using the Xi-steep method with configurable steepness
run_xi_cluster_algorithm: run the Xi-steep cluster extraction algorithm on a reachability plot to find nested cluster regions
